def: {hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a thousand}

occurrences.text: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.
A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
